styles.epic: Epic collectible-card illustration, luminous painterly fantasy art, a radiant sunburst of light rays behind the subject, glowing magic particles and lens sparkles, mirror-bright metal, rich saturated colour, deep dark midnight-blue and violet jewel-toned background, one subject, large and centred, filling the square, bold clear silhouette, friendly and heroic, made for children aged 5 to 11, no text, no letters, no numbers.

pictures.name: monster-book-trophy-bronze
pictures.prompt: A trophy shaped like an open storybook standing on a pedestal, little friendly monster faces peeking over the pages, a paw print on the cover, made of warm reddish-brown bronze metal, sturdy with hammered marks, a soft amber glow and just a few small sparkles. Nothing else in the picture.

pictures.name: monster-book
pictures.prompt: A glowing open storybook full of colourful friendly monster pictures, every page filled, little monsters jumping out of the pages in a swirl of golden sparkles, a soft halo of light behind it. The book and its monsters only: no people, no children, no human figures, no silhouettes.
